svg.title: Three Ways to Answer a Spoken Prompt
svg.desc: Lane one, audio-capable model: the spoken question is sent as an input_audio part with base64 data and a format such as wav, to a model such as gpt-audio, the gpt-realtime family or Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, which answers directly with text and a spoken reply when modalities include text and audio with a voice and format. Lane two, the Voice Live API: a managed, low-latency speech-to-speech service for live, session-based conversation. Lane three, Azure Speech plus a text model: speech to text, a text model, then text to speech; more parts to wire, but custom recognition and SSML.
svg.text: Three Ways to Answer a Spoken Prompt
An audio-capable model listens and thinks in one step; the other paths add a session or more parts.
